issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing sum(a, b) which adds two integers passed on the stack. The solution repository defines a sum label but its implementation only reads a single argument (mov eax, [esp+4]) and returns without adding the second parameter. This conflicts with the specified function signature/behavior and will confuse students who expect a reference implementation that consumes two stack parameters.
issues.suggestedFix:
Update the solution's sum implementation to consume both stack parameters and return their sum in eax, e.g.:
mov eax, [esp+4]
add eax, [esp+8]
ret
Also ensure any example usage (in main) demonstrates the correct calling convention (push b; push a; call sum; add esp, 8) so the solution matches the problem specification.
